content: {"like":["Prefers visually appealing films with pretty actors, costumes, and scenery.","Enjoys simple on-screen ideas and moral choices in characters.","Values dark comedy with uncomfortable humor and self‑reflection.","Loves family drama exploring instinctual consequences.","Appreciates sweet, familiar relationships and affectionate scenes."],"dislike":["Dislikes films that rely on effects over story, especially American ones.","Avoids poorly edited, poorly acted, or nonsensical shorts.","Rejects low production values and unmemorable supporting characters.","Frowns on films with limited gay content or weak focus on leads.","Dislikes subtitles that are hard to enable or not automatically on."]}
